Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Viva MagicCon: Las Vegas! What happens there might stay there, but you can get a full experience from the comfort of your own home with this year’s Festival in a Box: Las Vegas.
Inside each Mystery Booster 2 display box you’ll find 24 booster packs featuring cards with nearly 200 set symbols. Each 15-card pack includes one white-border card, one playtest card, and one Future Sight frame card which might even be one of 15 exclusively foil cards. Drafting will feel like you’re cracking packs from Magic’s past, Magic’s present, and Magic’s future.
You’ll also get the Slay the Day Foil Edition Secret Lair Drop, an exclusive part of Festival in a Box: Las Vegas 2025. These fan-favorite Commanders will be the best dressed at the table, thanks to the inspiring work and fashion instincts of artist Craig Drake.
Plus, the age-old question of who would win in a championship bout, a Sliver Hive or Ugin the massive spirit dragon Planeswalker, can finally be answered in gorgeous retro-frame foil. After the fight, everyone can head to the All You Can Eat Buffet playtest card for a celebratory meal.
All cards are English only.
Festival in a Box: Las Vegas 2025 is limited to 3 per customer.
Contents:
•1x Mystery Booster 2 Display (24 Booster packs in 1 Box)
•1x Foil Marwyn, the Nurturer
•1x Foil Liesa, Shroud of Dusk
•1x Foil Oloro, Ageless Ascetic
•1x Foil Sythis, Harvest's Hand
•1x Foil Sliver Hive
•1x Foil Ugin, the Spirit Dragon
•1x All-You-Can-Eat-Buffet playtest card

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
